blocks.text: English

表单、设置、会话这类对象状态，手写时要在每个修改点记得重算派生值、通知界面，退出时还要记得清理。`@migaia/store-light` 直接接收你平时写的对象：普通字段变成响应式值，getter 变成自动更新的派生值，方法变成一次发布的 Action，并提供订阅、持久化和释放。它还带一个异步值容器 `createStoreResource`，负责在没人使用时释放加载到的连接、解码器这类对象。它建立在 `@migaia/reactive` 之上，不依赖任何 UI 框架。

items: 派生值漏更新：改了商品列表，忘了同时更新合计和摘要。根因是派生值靠人在每个修改点手动重算。
监听者看到写了一半的状态：一个方法先改列表再改合计，监听者在两次写入之间运行，看到新列表配旧合计。根因是每次写入都单独通知。

退出后还显示上一个用户的数据：会话状态已经不用了，某个没清理的回调还在读它。根因是普通对象不知道自己已经被释放。
异步加载的对象没有关：组件卸载后连接、解码器还开着；重新加载后旧的那个一直留在内存里。根因是没人负责记录谁还在用它、何时该关。
写普通对象就行。 常见的响应式写法要把每个字段包成 signal、每个派生值包成 computed；这里字段、getter、方法自动变成响应式值、派生值和 Action，状态仍然长得像它描述的对象。示例

blocks.text: 全部签名、边界行为与错误信息见 USEGUIDE.md。下面是使用时最需要记住的约束。

1. getter 只读。 派生值没有 setter，给它赋值会抛 `TypeError`；只能通过它读取的字段间接改变。 2. 异步方法只有第一个 `await` 之前的写入在同一个批次里。 `await` 之后的写入要放进 `$batch()`。开启 `warnAsyncActions` 后，Action 第一次返回 thenable 时会经 Runtime 报告 `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY`。Action 保留方法原本的返回值或 Promise。 3. `$batch()` 不是事务。 recipe 中途抛错不会回滚已经完成的写入；`$hydrate()` 也一样。 4. `$dispose()` 先切换状态再释放。 `$disposed` 在释放任何资源之前就变成 `true`；之后读写字段、调用方法抛 `STORE_DISPOSED`，`$disposed`、`$runtime`、`$async` 和再次 `$dispose()` 仍可用。所有调用返回同一个 Promise，它在所有内部节点和 `$own()` 登记的资源释放完成后才完成。 5. 构造失败会回滚。 构造过程中任一步出错，已经创建的节点按注册的逆序释放，原始错误继续向外抛；清理本身失败时附加到原错误上，不会替换它。 6. 导入时不创建默认 Runtime。 第一次不传 `options.runtime` 创建 store 时才取得 reactive 的共享默认 Runtime，它和 `@migaia/reactive` 根入口导出的 `defaultRuntime` 是同一个对象。 7. StoreResource 的值由它持有。 配了 `dispose` 时值必须是对象或函数；没配而值自带 `$dispose` 时会调用它。没有持有者之后的回收倒计时是 `keepAliveMs`（默认 1000，`0` 表示同步回收）；React 渲染期间由 capture/commit 租约保护正在显示的版本。 8. 错误身份。 本包产生的错误带 `source === STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`（`@migaia/store-light`）和 `StoreLightErrorCode` 里的 `code`；来自 reactive 的所有权错误、来自 resource 的请求失败和取消保留原来的身份。
请求、数据、取消和共享 Promise 由 `@migaia/resource` 的一个实例负责，StoreResource 只在其上加值的所有权、渲染 capture、版本租约和恰好一次的释放。迁移说明（`StoreResourceDataKind`、`StoreResourceKind`、`retain()` 的移除）见 USEGUIDE 末尾。
不适合的场景：列表或频繁增删的集合、需要按 id 寻址的实体、需要索引查询的数据，分别用 store-indexed、store-keyed 等包。

sections.id: 写普通对象就得到响应式状态
sections.heading: 写普通对象就得到响应式状态

blocks.text: 购物车有商品列表、合计和一行摘要。手写时，每个改列表的方法都要记得重算摘要、通知监听者；监听者如果在两次写入之间运行，看到的是新列表配旧合计。
响应式库能解决这个问题，但通常要求把每个字段包成 signal、每个派生值包成 computed，状态就不再像它描述的那个对象了。
`createStore` 直接接收你平时写的对象：普通字段变成可写的响应式值，getter 变成派生值，读到的字段变了它就重算；方法变成 Action，一次调用里的所有写入在方法返回时一起发布。
输出：

blocks.code:
通知：1 件，共 300 元
通知：2 件，共 400 元

blocks.text: 调用两次 `add`，收到两次通知，每次通知里列表和合计都已经是新的。
Action 在返回时立即发布一次，监听者不会看到一个方法只写了一半的状态。不在方法里、直接给字段赋值的写入，则在下一个微任务里合并。
设置项保存在本地存储里。升级之后，有些旧字段已经删掉，又新增了字段；恢复旧 JSON 时，要么写进状态里没有的键，要么悄悄丢掉数据却没人发现。
手写持久化通常把整个对象序列化，派生值和方法也带上，恢复时用 `Object.assign`，给什么就拷什么。
`$plain()` 只返回可写字段。`$hydrate()` 只写回这个 store 有的字段，并在一个批次里完成；传 `unknown: 'report'` 时，每跳过一个键就调用一次 `onUnknown`，传 `unknown: 'strict'` 则整份输入直接拒绝。
输出：
保存的 JSON 里只有 `theme` 和 `fontSize`，没有 `label` 和 `reset`。恢复到新版本时，`fontSize` 和 `legacyMode` 被报告为已忽略，结果保留了 `theme` 和新增的 `language`。
默认的 `unknown: 'ignore'` 会静默跳过未知键；想记录迁移情况就用 `report`，输入有误就必须整份拒绝时用 `strict`。

blocks.text: 退出登录后会话状态已经释放，但某个没清理的定时器或回调还在读它，悄悄显示出上一个用户的名字。
普通对象不知道自己已经不用了，过期的读取方拿到的是旧值而不是错误，问题只会表现为数据不对。
调用 `$dispose()` 之后，读写字段、调用方法都会抛 `STORE_DISPOSED`。`$disposed` 在释放任何资源之前就变成 `true`；重复调用 `$dispose()` 返回同一个 Promise。

blocks.code:
读取失败：STORE_DISPOSED
已释放：true

blocks.text: 迟到的读取以 `STORE_DISPOSED` 失败，`$disposed` 为 `true`。
被遗忘的读取方现在会在读取的那一行报错，而不是在界面上显示过期数据。

sections.id: 把回调保存成可替换的字段
sections.heading: 把回调保存成可替换的字段

blocks.text: 表单在 store 里保存一个 `onSubmit` 回调，页面运行时会更换它。直接把函数写进 store 定义，它会被当成方法。
`createStore` 会把每个函数都变成 Action，光看对象没法分辨一个函数是字段还是方法。
用 `raw()` 包住这个值，就把它标记为数据：字段可读可写，赋一个新函数会通知订阅者，调用时执行的是当前的函数。
输出：

blocks.code:
默认提交：草稿
提交回调已更换
发送到服务器：正式稿

blocks.text: 第一次提交运行默认回调；更换回调时订阅者收到通知，第二次提交运行的是新回调。
凡是要原样保存、不希望被解释的值，例如回调、外部传入的类实例、格式化函数，都用 `raw()` 包住。

sections.id: 没人使用之后自动释放异步值
sections.heading: 没人使用之后自动释放异步值

blocks.text: 组件挂载时打开一个连接或解码器，最后一个需要它的组件卸载后应该关掉它，但又不该马上关，因为下一个页面往往还要用。
手写时用一个模块变量数使用者，组件里任何一次提前返回或抛错都可能漏掉一次减一，资源就一直开着。
`createStoreResource` 持有加载到的值。`retainResource()` 返回一个释放函数；没有任何持有者之后，值再保留 `keepAliveMs`（默认 1000 毫秒），然后调用一次 `dispose`。
输出：

blocks.code:
打开 连接 #1
读取：连接 #1
组件卸载
关闭 连接 #1
结束

blocks.text: 连接只打开一次，组件持有期间可以读取，组件卸载约 20 毫秒后关闭。
没有传 `dispose` 选项、而值自带 `$dispose` 方法时，会改为调用它。`keepAliveMs: 0` 表示最后一个持有者离开时立即同步释放。

sections.id: 重新加载时旧值只释放一次
sections.heading: 重新加载时旧值只释放一次

blocks.text: 重新加载会创建一个新的解码器。旧的必须释放，但要等新的准备好之后再释放，界面才不会空着；而且绝不能释放两次。
手写的重新加载代码，往往在新值到达之前就释放了旧值，或者走到错误分支时忘了释放；被取代之后才返回的值更是直接泄漏。
`retry()` 发起新的加载，在新值发布之前一直保留旧值，之后把旧值释放一次。被取代之后才到达的值、资源释放之后才到达的值，也都会被释放。
输出：

blocks.code:
创建解码器 #1
正在使用 #1
创建解码器 #2
释放解码器 #1
正在使用 #2
释放解码器 #2
全部释放完成

blocks.text: 先创建 #2，再释放 #1，组件读到的是 #2。释放资源时释放了 #2，`whenTerminal()` 在全部释放完成后才完成。
加载函数创建的每个值，不管以哪种方式结束，都只被释放一次。

纯 Signal/Computed Store 不建立异步 lifecycle scope；遇到 FieldBuilder、source capability、订阅 Effect 或 `$own` 外部资源时才创建。相邻原生节点合为一个同步逆序释放段，在不同资源边界登记该段，保持原混合 LIFO。初始化 AbortController 只在第一个 Builder 准入时通过 lifecycle native factory 创建。`$dispose()` 的 Promise identity、外部异步清理与错误策略保持。

sections.heading: 8. StoreResource：Suspense 安全的异步值容器

blocks.text: `createStoreResource(factory, options?)` 创建一个独立于对象 facade 的异步值容器，`createStoreResourceScope()` 管理一组资源的统一释放。两者都不要求配合 `createStore` 使用。
请求、数据、取消和共享 Promise 由 `@migaia/resource` 唯一拥有；下图是 StoreLight 结合版本租约派生的视图。

blocks.code:
idle --start()--> loading --resolve--> ready --无持有者+超时--> idle（缓存过期，值被释放）
                     |                   |
                     +---reject--------> failed（若有 stale 值则退回 ready 并保留旧值）
ready/loading --dispose()（有持有者）--> closing --最后一个持有者释放--> disposed
任意非 disposed 状态 --forceDispose()/dispose()（无持有者）--> disposed

items: `idle`：尚未开始加载。
`loading`：`factory` 正在执行；若存在上一个已加载的值（`retry()` 触发的重新加载），该值作为 `previous` 保留，读取时可以拿到旧值而不是挂起。
`ready`：已有值可读。
`failed`：加载失败且没有可回退的旧值；有旧值时优先回退到 `ready`（保留旧值），不会转到 `failed`。
`closing`：`dispose()` 时如果还有持有者（resource lease 或 version lease），资源进入这个中间态，等最后一个持有者释放才真正终止；不存在"半关闭"对外可见状态。
`disposed`：逻辑终态，实际 disposer 完成后 `whenTerminal()` 才 resolve，所有方法要么 no-op 要么抛 `[store] resource is disposed`。

blocks.text: `factory` 既可以是函数 `(context) => T \| Promise<T>`，也可以是 `{ load, runtime?, scheduler?, dispose?, keepAliveMs?, onError?, onTerminal? }` 对象形式（等价于把这些字段和 `options` 合并）。`IStoreResourceLoadContext` 提供 `{ signal, generation, token }`，`signal` 在该次加载被取代/资源关闭时中止。

构造时只读取上述已知字段并形成稳定快照：`load` 与每个已知 accessor 最多读取一次，不枚举或执行未知字段 getter；显式 `options` 的 own-enumerable 字段覆盖 factory 对象上的同名字段。`dispose`、`onError`、`onTerminal` 若存在必须是函数，否则在任何请求或 Resource 状态建立前同步抛出 tagged `INVALID_OPTION`。

自动 `$dispose` 与自定义 disposer 的返回值遵循 lifecycle 的统一接纳语义：disposer getter、then getter 均只读取一次，捕获函数分别以原资源、原 thenable 作为 receiver 调用。getter、调用或异步 rejection 的原始异常通过 `onError(error, 'dispose')` 可达；重复 `forceDispose()` 不会重复清理同一值。

`scope.resource()` 原样委托 `createStoreResource()` 的已知字段快照与 callback precedence，不会再次 spread/枚举 factory；用户的 effective `onTerminal` 保持不变。Scope 通过 `whenTerminal()` 从私有集合摘除自然终止的资源，不改写公开 disposer。`scope.dispose()` 会强制释放（`forceDispose`）组内所有仍然存在的资源，不等待持有者释放——它假定"整个作用域要关闭了，个别资源的持有者不再重要"。

`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。

本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

blocks.text: Store 构造失败：`shape` 里任意字段处理阶段抛错（比如某个 `FieldBuilder.create()` 抛错），整个构造过程回滚——原生节点同步分段释放、外部资源由 lifecycle scope 释放，内部的 `signals`/`computeds`/`wasmFields`/`fieldSources` 全部清空，原始错误继续向外抛出（清理阶段自身失败时，会尽量把清理错误挂到原错误的 `cause` 上，不会替换原始错误）。

异步字段初始化失败：`readyList` 中任一 Promise reject，Store 立即被标记为 `disposed = true`，中止其余在途初始化（`initAbort.abort()`），并回收已经创建的资源；这个转变发生在 `ready` Promise 的 reject 路径里，因此哪怕调用方没有 `await storeReady()`，Store 内部状态也已经正确收敛，不会有"部分字段可用"的僵尸状态。

`$dispose()` 时机：字段读写方法在闭包里直接引用底层节点（`node.value`），不经过任何"Store 对象本身"的代理层；因此 `$dispose()` 唯一要做的事就是把 `disposed` 标志位翻转、释放原生节点段与已有 scope、清空内部 Map。所有已经拿到 Store 引用的调用方，后续用户字段读写与受守卫方法调用会看到 `[store] store is disposed`。

`StoreResource` 的持有者概念：一份值被判定为"没有持有者"（可以被回收）需要同时满足：没有 `retainResource()`/`retainVersion()` 产生的活跃 lease，也没有任何未提交的 capture。直接 `captureVersion()` 不设 4 秒过期；只有 pending generation 成功后转换的 provisional capture 才有 4000ms 放弃窗口。`keepAliveMs` 超时只在"当前没有任何持有者"时才开始计算，一旦有新的持有者出现，倒计时会被取消。
一个"用户设置面板"场景：本地可写字段用严格 action 守卫，远端用户资料用 `StoreResource` 异步加载，并在组件卸载时统一释放。
Q：我在 getter 里写 `this.x = 1` 报错了。 Computed 只有 getter、没有 setter，属性描述符层面就不可写；ESM 严格模式下赋值给这样的属性会抛 `TypeError`。派生值只能通过它依赖的 signal 字段间接改变。
Q：`store.field = x` 没报错，但我明明传了 `mutationPolicy`。 检查是不是走了 `$batch`/`$set`/`$hydrate` 或方法（Action）内部——这几条路径会先 `runInAction()` 再执行，动作深度 > 0 时 `assertMutationAllowed` 自然放行。只有"在这些路径之外直接赋值"才会被拦截。
Q：`createStore()` 报 "only accepts synchronous fields"，但我看代码是同步的。 检查 `FieldBuilder.mode` 是否显式为 `'sync'`；异步字段使用 `'async'` 并交给 `createAsyncStore()`。无 mode 的历史形式已移除。

Q：`StoreResource.read()` 一直抛同一个 Promise，界面卡在 loading。 确认调用方确实在 Suspense 边界内 `await`/处理了这个抛出的 Promise；`read()` 抛 Promise 是设计如此（React Suspense 协议），不是错误——真正的问题通常是外层没有 `<Suspense>` 或没有等待 Promise settle 就再次同步渲染。
Q：`retry()` 之后旧值突然消失了。 `retry()` 只保证"重新加载完成前，旧值继续可读"；如果旧值没有任何 `retainVersion` 锁定，加载成功后旧值会按正常的 retire/回收流程被清理（触发 `dispose` 配置或值自身的 `$dispose`）。需要强制保留某个版本用 `retainVersion(version)`。

Q：`$plain()`/`$hydrate()` 和 `$snapshot()` 有什么区别，该用哪个？ `$snapshot()` 拿"当前展示状态"（含 computed/wasm 字段），要求 Store 已就绪；`$plain()`/`$hydrate()` 只处理可持久化的标量 signal 字段，且不要求 Store 已就绪——持久化/hydration 场景应该用后者，展示/调试场景用前者。

For object state such as forms, settings or a session, hand-written code has to recompute derived values and notify the page at every change, and remember to clean up on the way out. `@migaia/store-light` takes the object as you would write it: plain fields become reactive values, getters become derived values that update themselves, methods become actions that publish once, and the store adds subscription, persistence and disposal. It also has an async value container, `createStoreResource`, that releases loaded objects such as connections or decoders when nobody uses them. It is built on `@migaia/reactive` and depends on no UI framework.

items: A derived value is not updated: the item list changed, but the total and the summary were not updated with it. The cause is that derived values are recomputed by hand at every place that changes the data.

Listeners see half-written state: a method changes the list and then the total, and a listener runs between the two writes and sees the new list with the old total. The cause is that every write notifies on its own.

Restoring settings silently loses data: after an upgrade, restoring saved settings writes retired fields into the state, or drops fields the new version lacks without anyone noticing. The cause is persistence through something like `Object.assign`, which copies whatever it is given.

The previous user's data is still on screen after sign-out: the session state is no longer used, but a callback nobody cleaned up still reads it. The cause is that a plain object never knows it has been released.

Async-loaded objects are never closed: a connection or decoder stays open after the component unmounts, and after a reload the old one stays in memory. The cause is that nobody records who still uses it and when it should close.

Just write a plain object. The usual reactive style wraps every field in a signal and every derived value in a computed; here fields, getters and methods become reactive values, derived values and actions, and the state still looks like the object it describes. Example
An action publishes once when it returns. All writes inside one method call are announced together when it returns, so listeners never see half-written state. Example
Persistence takes only what can be restored. `$plain()` returns only the writable fields; `$hydrate()` writes back only fields the store has and can report or reject unknown ones. Example

Access after disposal fails at once. After `$dispose()`, reading or writing a field and calling a method throw `STORE_DISPOSED`, so a stale reader fails where it reads instead of showing old data. Example

Async values have a clear owner. `createStoreResource` tracks holders and releases the value `keepAliveMs` after the last holder leaves; a reload releases the old value only after the new one is published, and every value is released exactly once. Example

blocks.text: Every signature, boundary behaviour and error message is in USEGUIDE.en.md. These are the constraints that matter most in use.

1. Getters are read-only. A derived value has no setter, and assigning to it throws `TypeError`; change it only through the fields it reads. 2. In an async method, only writes before the first `await` share the batch. Put writes after an `await` into `$batch()`. With `warnAsyncActions`, the first thenable an action returns is reported through the Runtime as `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY`. Actions keep the method's own return value or Promise. 3. `$batch()` is not a transaction. A recipe that throws halfway does not roll back writes already made; the same holds for `$hydrate()`. 4. `$dispose()` flips the state before releasing. `$disposed` becomes `true` before any resource is released; afterwards reading or writing a field and calling a method throw `STORE_DISPOSED`, while `$disposed`, `$runtime`, `$async` and another `$dispose()` keep working. Every call returns the same Promise, which completes after every internal node and every resource registered through `$own()` has been released. 5. A failed construction rolls back. If any step of construction fails, the nodes already created are released in reverse registration order and the original error keeps propagating; a failing cleanup is attached to the original error instead of replacing it. 6. Importing creates no default Runtime. The shared default Runtime of reactive is taken the first time a store is created without `options.runtime`, and it is the same object as the `defaultRuntime` exported from the root of `@migaia/reactive`. 7. StoreResource owns its values. With a `dispose` option, values must be objects or functions; without one, a value's own `$dispose` method is called. The countdown after the last holder leaves is `keepAliveMs` (default 1000; `0` releases synchronously); during React rendering, capture/commit leases protect the version on screen. 8. Error identity. Errors produced by this module carry `source === STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE` (`@migaia/store-light`) and a `code` from `StoreLightErrorCode`; ownership errors from reactive and request failures and cancellations from resource keep their original identity.

Requests, data, cancellation and the shared Promise are handled by one instance of `@migaia/resource`; StoreResource only adds value ownership, render captures, version leases and exactly-once release on top. Migration notes (removal of `StoreResourceDataKind`, `StoreResourceKind` and `retain()`) are at the end of the USEGUIDE.
When not to use it: for lists and collections with frequent inserts and removals, entities addressed by id, or data that needs index queries, use store-indexed, store-keyed and the related module.

sections.heading: Plain object in, reactive state out

blocks.text: A cart keeps a list, a total and a summary line. Hand-written, every method that changes the list must also recompute the summary and notify listeners, and a listener that runs between two writes sees a new list with the old total.
Reactive libraries fix that, but usually by asking you to wrap every field in a signal and every derived value in a computed, so the state no longer looks like the object it describes.

`createStore` takes the object as you would write it. Plain fields become writable reactive values, getters become derived values that recompute when what they read changes, and methods become actions: all writes inside one call are published together when the call returns.
Output:

blocks.code:
notified: items: 1, total: 300
notified: items: 2, total: 400

blocks.text: Two calls to `add` produce two notifications, and each one already sees both the new list and the new total.
An action publishes once, right when it returns, so a listener never observes half of a method's writes. Writes made directly on fields, outside any method, are merged in the next microtask instead.

sections.heading: Save only what can be restored

blocks.text: Settings are saved to local storage. After an upgrade some saved fields no longer exist and new ones were added; restoring the old JSON either writes keys the state does not have or silently loses data nobody noticed.
Hand-written persistence usually serializes the whole object, including derived values and methods, and restores with `Object.assign`, which copies whatever it is given.

`$plain()` returns only the writable fields. `$hydrate()` writes back only the fields this store has, in one batch; with `unknown: 'report'` it calls `onUnknown` for every key it skips, and `unknown: 'strict'` rejects the whole input instead.
Output:

The saved JSON contains `theme` and `fontSize` but not `label` or `reset`. Restoring into the new version reports `fontSize` and `legacyMode` as ignored, and the result keeps `theme` and the new `language`.
The default `unknown: 'ignore'` skips unknown keys silently; choose `report` when you want to log migrations and `strict` when bad input must not be applied at all.

sections.heading: Reading a released store fails loudly

blocks.text: After sign-out the session state is released, but a timer or a callback that was never cleaned up keeps reading it and quietly shows the previous user's name.
A plain object never knows it is no longer in use, so stale readers get old values instead of an error, and the bug only shows up as wrong data.

After `$dispose()`, reading or writing a field and calling a method throw `STORE_DISPOSED`. `$disposed` turns `true` before any resource is released, and repeated `$dispose()` calls return the same Promise.
Output:

blocks.code:
read failed: STORE_DISPOSED
disposed: true

blocks.text: The late read fails with `STORE_DISPOSED`, and `$disposed` is `true`.
A forgotten reader now shows up as an error at the exact place it reads, instead of as stale data on screen.

sections.heading: Keep a callback as a replaceable field

blocks.text: A form stores an `onSubmit` callback that the page swaps at run time. Written as a function in the store definition, it is treated as a method instead.
`createStore` turns every function into an action, so a function-valued field cannot be told apart from a method by looking at the object.
Wrapping the value in `raw()` marks it as data: the field stays readable and writable, assigning a new function notifies subscribers, and calling it runs the current function.
Output:

blocks.code:
default submit: draft
submit callback replaced
sent to the server: final

blocks.text: The first submit runs the default callback; replacing it notifies the subscriber, and the second submit runs the new one.
Use `raw()` for any function or value that should be stored as is rather than interpreted, such as callbacks, class instances handed in from outside, or formatter functions.

sections.heading: Release an async value when nobody uses it

blocks.text: A component opens a connection or a decoder when it mounts. When the last component that needs it unmounts it should be closed, but not immediately, because the next page often needs it again.
Hand-written code counts users in a module variable, and every early return or thrown error in a component is a chance to miss a decrement, leaving the resource open forever.
`createStoreResource` owns the loaded value. `retainResource()` returns a release function; when no holder is left, the value stays for `keepAliveMs` (default 1000) and then `dispose` is called once.
Output:

blocks.code:
open connection #1
read: connection #1
component unmounted
close connection #1
done

blocks.text: The connection opens once, is read while the component holds it, and closes about 20 ms after the component unmounts.
When no `dispose` option is given and the value has a `$dispose` method, that method is called instead. `keepAliveMs: 0` releases synchronously when the last holder leaves.

sections.heading: Reloading releases the old value exactly once

blocks.text: A reload creates a new decoder. The old one must be released, but only after the new one is ready, so the screen never shows nothing, and it must never be released twice.
Hand-written reload code tends to dispose the old value before the new one arrives, or forgets it once an error path is taken; values that resolve after being superseded leak entirely.

`retry()` starts a new load and keeps the old value until the new one is published, then disposes the old one once. Values that arrive after being superseded, or after the resource is disposed, are released as well.
Output:

blocks.code:
create decoder #1
using #1
create decoder #2
release decoder #1
using #2
release decoder #2
everything released

blocks.text: Decoder #2 is created first, then #1 is released, and the component reads #2. Disposing the resource releases #2, and `whenTerminal()` resolves after everything is released.
Each value created by the loader is released exactly once, whichever way it ends.

sections.heading: 8. StoreResource: a Suspense-safe async value container

blocks.text: `createStoreResource(factory, options?)` creates an async value container independent of the object facade, and `createStoreResourceScope()` releases a group of resources together. Neither needs `createStore`.
Requests, data, cancellation and the shared Promise are owned only by `@migaia/resource`; the diagram below is the view StoreLight derives from it together with version leases.

blocks.code:
idle --start()--> loading --resolve--> ready --no holder + timeout--> idle (cache expired, value released)
                     |                   |
                     +---reject--------> failed (falls back to ready with the old value when one exists)
ready/loading --dispose() (holders left)--> closing --last holder released--> disposed
any state except disposed --forceDispose()/dispose() (no holder)--> disposed

items: `idle`: loading has not started.
`loading`: `factory` is running; when an earlier value exists (a reload started by `retry()`), it is kept as `previous`, and reads return the old value instead of suspending.
`ready`: a value can be read.
`failed`: loading failed and there is no older value to fall back to; with an older value, the state falls back to `ready` (keeping it) instead of `failed`.

`closing`: when `dispose()` is called while holders (resource leases or version leases) remain, the resource enters this intermediate state and terminates only when the last holder releases; no half-closed state is visible from outside.
`disposed`: the logical end state. `whenTerminal()` resolves only after the actual disposers finish, and every method is either a no-op or throws `[store] resource is disposed`.

blocks.text: `factory` may be a function `(context) => T \| Promise<T>` or an object `{ load, runtime?, scheduler?, dispose?, keepAliveMs?, onError?, onTerminal? }` (equivalent to merging those fields with `options`). `IStoreResourceLoadContext` provides `{ signal, generation, token }`; `signal` aborts when that load is superseded or the resource closes.

Construction reads only the known fields above into a stable snapshot: `load` and each known accessor are read at most once, and unknown field getters are neither enumerated nor run; own enumerable fields of an explicit `options` override fields of the same name on the factory object. `dispose`, `onError` and `onTerminal` must be functions when present; otherwise a tagged `INVALID_OPTION` is thrown synchronously before any request or Resource state is created.

Automatic `$dispose` and custom disposers follow lifecycle's common admission rules: the disposer getter and the `then` getter are each read once, and the captured functions are called with the original resource and the original thenable as receiver. The original exception of a getter, a call or an async rejection is reachable through `onError(error, 'dispose')`; repeated `forceDispose()` never cleans the same value twice.

`scope.resource()` delegates to `createStoreResource()` as is, with the same known-field snapshot and callback precedence, and never spreads or enumerates the factory again; the user's effective `onTerminal` is unchanged. The scope removes resources that end on their own from its private set through `whenTerminal()`, without rewriting any public disposer. `scope.dispose()` force-releases (`forceDispose`) every resource still in the group without waiting for holders: it assumes the whole scope is closing and individual holders no longer matter.

blocks.text: These four factories are the tools this module uses to build all of its own errors. They are exported for advanced integrations that want to throw their own diagnostics under the `@migaia/store-light` identity (for example a custom `FieldBuilder` reusing the same identity convention); everyday code does not call them, and simply catches this module's errors and branches on `error.code` (see the table below).

Errors created by this module use `source: '@migaia/store-light'` and a stable `code`. Reactive ownership errors and Resource request failures and cancellations keep their original owner. FieldBuilder initialization failures and late field cleanup failures keep a complete existing identity; other native extensible Errors are marked `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED` on the original object, keeping type, message and stack; values that cannot carry an identity stay reachable through the `cause` of a coded fallback. When initialization and cleanup both fail, the primary Error stays the original object when its cause can be written, and an existing cause is merged with the cleanup failure; otherwise an `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError is used.

blocks.text: Failed store construction: when processing any field of `shape` throws (for example a `FieldBuilder.create()` throws), the whole construction rolls back: native nodes are released synchronously in segments, outside resources are released by the lifecycle scope, the internal `signals`/`computeds`/`wasmFields`/`fieldSources` are cleared, and the original error keeps propagating (when cleanup itself fails, the cleanup error is attached to the original error's `cause` where possible, never replacing it).

Failed async field initialization: when any Promise in `readyList` rejects, the store is marked `disposed = true` at once, the remaining initializations in flight are aborted (`initAbort.abort()`), and the resources already created are released. This happens in the reject path of the `ready` Promise, so even when the caller never awaits `storeReady()`, the store has converged correctly and never sits in a zombie state with some fields usable.

When `$dispose()` takes effect: field reads and writes reference the underlying nodes (`node.value`) directly in closures, with no proxy over the store object. `$dispose()` therefore only has to flip the `disposed` flag, release the native node segments and the existing scope, and clear the internal maps. Every caller that already holds the store sees `[store] store is disposed` on later user-field reads, writes and guarded method calls.

StoreResource holders: a value counts as having no holder (and can be reclaimed) only when there is no active lease from `retainResource()`/`retainVersion()` and no uncommitted capture. A direct `captureVersion()` has no 4-second expiry; only the provisional capture converted after a pending generation succeeds has the 4000 ms abandonment window. The `keepAliveMs` countdown starts only when there is no holder at all, and is cancelled as soon as a new holder appears.

A "user settings panel": local writable fields use a strict actions-only guard, the remote profile loads asynchronously through `StoreResource`, and everything is released together when the component unmounts.

Q: Writing `this.x = 1` inside a getter throws. A computed has only a getter and no setter, so the property is not writable at the descriptor level; assigning to it in ESM strict mode throws `TypeError`. A derived value changes only through the signal fields it depends on.

Q: `store.field = x` did not throw, although I passed `mutationPolicy`. Check whether the write went through `$batch`/`$set`/`$hydrate` or a method (action): these paths call `runInAction()` first, so `assertMutationAllowed` allows writes while the action depth is above zero. Only assignments outside those paths are blocked.

Q: `createStore()` says "only accepts synchronous fields", but the code looks synchronous. Check that `FieldBuilder.mode` is explicitly `'sync'`; async fields use `'async'` and go to `createAsyncStore()`. The legacy form without a mode has been removed.

Q: `StoreResource.read()` keeps throwing the same Promise and the page is stuck loading. Make sure the caller sits inside a Suspense boundary that awaits or handles the thrown Promise; throwing a Promise from `read()` is by design (the React Suspense protocol), not an error. The real problem is usually a missing `<Suspense>`, or rendering again synchronously before the Promise settles.

Q: The old value disappeared after `retry()`. `retry()` only guarantees that the old value stays readable until the reload completes. If no `retainVersion` locks the old value, it is retired and cleaned up normally once loading succeeds (running the `dispose` option or the value's own `$dispose`). Use `retainVersion(version)` to keep a version.

Q: What is the difference between `$plain()`/`$hydrate()` and `$snapshot()`? `$snapshot()` returns the current display state (including computeds and wasm fields) and requires the store to be ready; `$plain()`/`$hydrate()` handle only persistable signal fields and do not require readiness. Use the latter for persistence and hydration, the former for display and debugging.
From the repository root: `pnpm --filter @migaia/store-light fmt` → `lint` → `typecheck` → `typecheck:test` → `test` → `build`. The browser integration path also runs `typecheck:e2e` and `test:e2e`.

Importing Store light alone creates no default Runtime. The shared default instance of reactive is taken only the first time a store is created without an explicit `options.runtime`; with an explicit runtime, construction uses that owner directly. The instance is the same object as the `defaultRuntime` later imported from the reactive root.

Actions keep the method's own return value or Promise outside the synchronous mutation callback. Only writes before the first `await` share that batch; use `$batch()` for writes after it. Mutation-policy callbacks stay synchronous. With `warnAsyncActions`, the first thenable an action returns is reported as `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY` through the store's Runtime.

StoreResource uses the Runtime captured at creation for idle cleanup and diagnostics, and its admitted scheduler for the cache lifetime and the 4000 ms provisional capture window. `keepAliveMs: 0` still evicts synchronously. Without `onError`, the original failure goes to the Runtime; when a user reporter throws or rejects, both the original failure and the reporter failure reach the Runtime as the original objects. There is no fallback to the host console or a global reportError.

sections.heading: Migration note: requests handed to Resource

blocks.text: StoreLight now adapts one `@migaia/resource` instance. It keeps the identity of actual values, render captures, resource and version leases and value release, and deletes its own duplicate request/data controller and request coordinator. `StoreResourceDataKind` and its type are removed; use `ResourceStatus` / `ResourceFetchStatus` for native Resource state. `StoreResourceKind` remains internal facade vocabulary; `readSnapshot()` still returns `value`/`version`/`token` and has no public kind property.

Repeated reads while loading throw the same Promise, which resolves with the original value. `retry()` or a forced cancellation rejects the superseded Promise at once with a native `AbortError`, source `@migaia/resource`, code `REQUEST_ABORTED`; previously a loader that ignored the abort could keep that Promise pending until it finished on its own. Handle the old Promise's rejection when driving retries by hand. Late returned values are released once. A failed refresh restores the old data; an old version lease delays its release until the lease is released. Loaded values still waiting for clock settlement remain owned and are released if settlement fails. When admitting the provisional-capture timer fails, the partial captures and timers are released and reported as release housekeeping; a value that loaded successfully stays readable and notifies subscribers. No async-context mechanism is introduced.

The root entry no longer exports `StoreResourceKind` or `IStoreResourceKind`; the ownership vocabulary stays internal, and public resources expose snapshots and completion methods. `ILegacyFieldBuilder` is removed: use `IAsyncFieldBuilder` with `mode: 'async'`. `IFieldBuilder` remains the union of explicit sync/async builders, including its store-wasm re-export. Replace `resource.retain()` with `retainResource()` and `resource.retain(version)` with `retainVersion(version)`. No compatibility alias remains. External usage is unknown; publish this as a breaking API change.

shape: Object literal with fields, getters, methods, raw values and explicit sync field builders. Keys must not collide with built-in $ APIs; a collision throws INVALID_OPTION TypeError and rolls back construction.

debugName: Prefix of internal node names in diagnostics.

mutationPolicy: Strict write policy (e.g. `createMutationPolicy("actions-only")` from `@migaia/store-middleware`): direct field writes outside actions throw.

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

members.description: Registers an external resource, such as a collection, with this store's ownership scope. A store can hold root UI state and actions while collections hold frequently accessed structures. Sharing a runtime alone does not share disposal ownership; `$own` prevents those structures from leaking when the root is disposed. The resource must be unowned or owned by this `Runtime`. sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
$runtime: Reactive runtime captured at construction. This public data property is writable; assigning it does not migrate the closed-over Runtime owner.
$async: Initially `true` when asynchronous fields were admitted. This public data property is writable and does not control initialization.
$snapshot: Returns a plain object with every field value, including computed and custom fields; throws while async fields are pending.
A new plain snapshot object.
$subscribe: Reads signal, computed and custom sources when subscribing, evaluating computed getters to capture dependencies outside this store. Later changes call `fn`; listener throws/rejections go to the Runtime reporter.
$subscribe.fn: Callback without arguments; read the store inside it.
$subscribe.options: `{ fireImmediately? }`: `true` also calls `fn` once right away; default `false`.
A function that unsubscribes.
$batch: Changes several fields with one notification. Not a transaction: a throw does not roll back earlier writes.
$batch.recipe: `(draft) => void`; assign fields on `draft`.
Nothing; dependants were notified once.
$set: Assigns several writable fields from a patch in one batch.
$set.patch: Partial object of writable (signal) fields; other keys throw `INVALID_OPTION`.
Nothing; the fields are updated.
$plain: Returns only the persistable plain fields (no computed, custom fields or methods); works before the store is ready.
A plain object for storage or JSON.
$hydrate: Writes saved values back into plain fields through the mutation policy and one notification batch. It is not a rollback transaction: earlier writes survive a later failure.
$hydrate.partial: Saved object, usually from `$plain()`.
$hydrate.options: `{ unknown?, onUnknown? }`; see `IHydrateOptions`.
Nothing; known fields are written.
$disposed: `true` after `$dispose()` was called.
$own: Adds an external disposable to this live store so `$dispose()` releases it too. After disposal, `$own` rejects with STORE_DISPOSED.
$own.resource: Object with `dispose()` and `disposed`, owned by no other runtime.
The same resource.
$dispose: Releases fields, subscriptions and owned resources in reverse registration order. Reentrant and later calls return the same completion Promise. Field access and guarded methods reject with STORE_DISPOSED; disposal and terminal metadata remain available.
Always the same Promise, resolved when cleanup finished.

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 第 6 节。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 第 6 节。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 第 6 节。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

blocks.text: Store 构造失败：`shape` 里任意字段处理阶段抛错（比如某个 `FieldBuilder.create()` 抛错），整个构造过程回滚——原生节点同步分段释放、外部资源由 lifecycle scope 释放，内部的 `signals`/`computeds`/`wasmFields`/`fieldSources` 全部清空，原始错误继续向外抛出（清理阶段自身失败时，会尽量把清理错误挂到原错误的 `cause` 上，不会替换原始错误）。

异步字段初始化失败：`readyList` 中任一 Promise reject，Store 立即被标记为 `disposed = true`，中止其余在途初始化（`initAbort.abort()`），并回收已经创建的资源；这个转变发生在 `ready` Promise 的 reject 路径里，因此哪怕调用方没有 `await storeReady()`，Store 内部状态也已经正确收敛，不会有"部分字段可用"的僵尸状态。

`$dispose()` 时机：字段读写方法在闭包里直接引用底层节点（`node.value`），不经过任何"Store 对象本身"的代理层；因此 `$dispose()` 唯一要做的事就是把 `disposed` 标志位翻转、释放原生节点段与已有 scope、清空内部 Map。所有已经拿到 Store 引用的调用方，后续用户字段读写与受守卫方法调用会看到 `[store] store is disposed`。

`StoreResource` 的持有者概念：一份值被判定为"没有持有者"（可以被回收）需要同时满足：没有 `retainResource()`/`retainVersion()` 产生的活跃 lease，也没有任何未提交的 capture。直接 `captureVersion()` 不设 4 秒过期；只有 pending generation 成功后转换的 provisional capture 才有 4000ms 放弃窗口。`keepAliveMs` 超时只在"当前没有任何持有者"时才开始计算，一旦有新的持有者出现，倒计时会被取消。
